title: Biophilic 3-inch FPV unibody frame, 3 mm CF_3K plate, 125 mm true-X
requirements: 3 inch (76.2 mm) props with real tip-to-tip clearance
survive crash loads on the arms
biophilic look: branching, tapering, leaf/vein cut-outs
manufacturable as a CNC-cut flat CF plate of one thickness (all cut-outs through, Z-prismatic)

parameters.name: plate_thickness
parameters.rationale: standard 3 mm unibody CF for 3-inch arms; bending check

parameters.name: motor_radius
parameters.rationale: centre-to-motor = 125 mm diagonal wheelbase / 2; adjacent motors 88.4 mm apart

parameters.name: prop_diameter
parameters.rationale: 3 inch prop, used for clearance checks

parameters.name: motor_hole_spacing
parameters.rationale: 12x12 mm square pattern, 1404/1505 class

parameters.name: motor_hole_d
parameters.rationale: M2 clearance

parameters.name: motor_center_hole_d
parameters.rationale: shaft/circlip relief under the bell

parameters.name: pad_r
parameters.rationale: 17 mm pad core, about the 18 mm motor base

parameters.name: pad_lobe_r
parameters.rationale: petal around each M2 hole: 1.9 mm edge wall

parameters.name: stack_spacing
parameters.rationale: 20x20 FC/ESC stack

parameters.name: stack_hole_d
parameters.rationale: M2 clearance

parameters.name: body_lobe_x
parameters.rationale: seed body: single capsule on the Y axis

parameters.name: body_lobe_y
parameters.rationale: body length 56 mm front to back

parameters.name: body_lobe_r
parameters.rationale: body half-width 14 mm, waist between arms; 2.9 mm rim outside stack holes

parameters.name: midrib_root_w
parameters.rationale: arm midrib root width, crash bending check

parameters.name: midrib_tip_w
parameters.rationale: tapered toward the motor (less mass where moment is low)

parameters.name: margin_root_w
parameters.rationale: leaf margin vein, root

parameters.name: margin_tip_w
parameters.rationale: leaf margin vein at the pad, at least 2x CF min wall

parameters.name: leaf_half_width
parameters.rationale: max half-width of the arm leaf outline; keeps outer vein slots open after filleting

parameters.name: vein_w
parameters.rationale: lateral veins, at least 1.5 mm CF min feature

parameters.name: fillet_r
parameters.rationale: grown-looking 2D concave fillets; 3.2 mm cutter-friendly

parameters.name: min_wall
parameters.rationale: CF_3K plate minimum feature

physics_checks.name: prop_to_stack_clearance
physics_checks.formula: √2·(R/√2 − 12.75) − D/2 for a 25.5 mm square stack board, mm

physics_checks.name: bending_stress_sf
physics_checks.formula: SF = σ / (F·L / (b·t²/6)); F = 40 N crash at motor, L = 42.5 mm, b = 8.4 mm midrib only, t = 3 mm → σ = 135 MPa vs 570 MPa

physics_checks.name: deflection
physics_checks.formula: δ = F·L³/(3·E·I), F = 3.4 N max thrust, L = 42.5 mm, E = 55 GPa, I = 7.5·3³/12 (midrib only), mm

physics_checks.name: wall_thickness_min
physics_checks.formula: min(vein_w, hole edge wall 3 − 1.1) ≥ CF min 1.5 mm

assumptions: AUW about 150 g; a 40 N one-arm crash load is about 27 g, first-order
conservative: only the midrib is counted for bending/deflection; margin veins add stiffness
quasi-isotropic 3K plate, E = 55 GPa, 570 MPa tensile (flexural strength is lower; SF covers it)
top plate, standoffs, camera mount and battery strap are not part of this plate
risks: first-order beam theory, not FEA; delamination at the cut edges is not modelled
sharp-impact crash loads can exceed 40 N
check the M2 hole edge wall (1.9 mm) against your CNC shop's minimum
